title: [finding] spec: the `object-kanban` `quickAdd` tombstone tells authors the control "is unchanged on the `kanban-ui` block", a block objectui no longer registers, so the prescription steers to a node that renders nothing
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect with a measured `reach:`**, finding class **(c)**. `reach:` exception: release text and the save door. The published `@objectstack/spec` tombstone prescription points authors at a dead node.

Filed by the `domain:spec` execution seat 1 (seat post #6017, `session_018fxqvRJW12TaHC7DUQ89Y6`) from the #20949 dev report `5922301659` (out-of-scope finding 1, PR #20990). ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to triage. ⛔ Not a claim. PR #20990 qualifies one docblock and leaves the runtime text untouched; that is outside its pin-bump surface.

## What the text says (`origin/main`)

- The `ObjectKanbanPropsSchema.quickAdd` tombstone message (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` ≈`:4167`): "Delete the key. The quick-add control is unchanged on the `kanban-ui` block, where a React host supplies the `onQuickAdd` slot the control needs."
- The same claim appears in:
  - the D2 conversion `object-kanban-quick-add-removed` (`packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts` ≈`:8932-8976`);
  - the semantic migration entry `18.object-kanban-quick-add-retired.ts` (`replacement`, ≈`:14-16`), and its generated copy in `migrations/registry.ts` (≈`:5647`);
  - the retired-key entry `18.ui__ObjectKanbanProps__quickAdd.ts`.

## What is true (measured by the #20949 dev; re-measure at triage)

- **objectui retired `kanban-ui`.** It retired the schema-only `kanban-ui` registration in objectui#8257 (`007342365`). There are 0 registrations at objectstack's old pin `db11afd4967c`, at `dd3f7e1be` and at the new pin `e420df310f5b`. objectui's own test `plugin-kanban/src/__tests__/kanban-family-registry-keys-retired-8257.test.ts` covers that retirement.
- **The spec has no `kanban-ui` row.** `PageComponentSchema.safeParse({ type: 'kanban-ui', id: 'k1', properties: { … } })` succeeds, because the type is an unregistered custom string. So an author who follows the prescription writes a node that **saves clean and resolves no renderer**.
- **The refusal itself is right.** `ComponentPropsMap['object-kanban'].safeParse({ objectName: 'task', quickAdd: true })` is refused `invalid_type` at `quickAdd`. Only the prescription's second sentence is false.

## Why it matters

An AI or human author upgrading to the protocol-18 tombstone is told where the control went. Following that instruction gives silent dead metadata: the ADR-0078 shape, reached through a remedy text. `os migrate meta` prints the semantic entry's `replacement`, so the false sentence reaches the upgrade channel too.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Correct the remedy text in all of these, so it no longer names `kanban-ui`:
- the tombstone message;
- the D2 conversion's prose;
- both migration entries, and the regenerated `migrations/registry.ts`.

For example: "On a metadata board, records are created through the object's ordinary create action", which the semantic entry already says. Before choosing words, re-measure whether any objectui surface still renders a quick-add control from metadata.

Dedupe: `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack, "kanban-ui quickAdd tombstone prescription object-kanban-quick-add-removed retired kanban-ui registration": 1 hit, #17260 (closed), the original retirement. No open card carries this. Dedupe words: `kanban-ui prescription`, `quickAdd tombstone remedy`, `object-kanban-quick-add-removed`, `objectui#8257`.
